What This Covers

  • Totals are the year-end figures from the LNC's FEC Form 3X reports for its federal account. 2026 has no year-end report yet; its figures are the year-to-date totals in the pre-general report, which runs to October 14, 2026.
  • Itemized payments come from the FEC's bulk files of operating expenditures (report line 21b), through October 14, 2026. The September report and the pre-general report (September 1 to October 14) come from the same filings through the FEC's API. Payments of $200 or less to one payee in a year are not itemized and are not here. Neither are other report lines, such as coordinated spending and refunds.
  • Each report is counted once, in its latest amended version.
  • Categories come from keyword rules on the purpose and the payee's name. The purposes are the treasurer's own words, so some payments are vague or sorted imperfectly. "Card payment, items not linked" holds credit-card payments whose purchases the filing did not itemize.
  • Known gap: none of the LNC's itemized 2022 payments is sorted as legal here, yet its own books show $63,723 in legal costs for 2022 (December 2022 monthly finance report, p.9). Why the filings show none is not explained yet.
  • Not here yet: the LNC's adopted budgets and budget-versus-actual reports. They are printed in the minutes but have not been gathered into a table.
  • The full sorted list, with every payment's FEC file and image number, is in the project folder as LNC-Spending-2005-2026.xlsx.
